page.layout: One page of running text in the centre, with marginal notes in the left margin. A strip of the neighbouring right-hand page is cut off at the right edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: tiones non scriptæ in regula fidei ? Expediat hæc, qui potest.

{a}Excellentia canonicæ auctoritatis veteris & novi Testamenti (ut alia etiam ex eodem anne-ctamus, ad quæ nihil respondet Cardinalis) Apostolorum confirmata temporibus, per successiones Episcoporum, & propagationes Ecclesiarum, tanquam in sede quadam sublimiter constituta est, cui seruiat omnis fidelis & pius intellectus, inquit Augustinus. Quibus verbis probat, Tridentinum intellectum & spiritum nec fidelem, nec pium esse, qui huic auctoritati non seruiat: qui hanc regulam, & auctoritatis excellentiam per successiones Episcoporum, & propagationes Ecclesiarum ad Tridentinum usque Concilium in Ecclesia conseruatam; cum primum immutare auderet, & ad verbum Dei, verbum Papæ in eadem auctoritatis excellentia addere.cont. Faust. Manich. lib. XI.[?] cap. 5.

{b}Tantummodo scripturis canonicis, inquit Augustinus, hanc ingenuam seruitutem debeo. At Tridentini non solis canonicis scripturis, sed traditionibus non scriptis hanc seruitutem profitentur.Epist. 19.

{c}Non afferamus, inquit Augustinus idem stateras dolosas, ubi appendamus, quod volumus, & quomodo volumus pro arbitrio nostro, dicentes, hoc graue, hoc leue est; sed afferamus divinam stateram de Scripturis sanctis, tanquam de thesauris Dominicis, & in illis, quid sit grauius, appendamus; imo non appendamus, sed a Domino appensa recognoscamus. Hæc ille.lib. 2. cap. 3. de Baptism. contr. Donatist.
Hæc igitur de Scripturis docuit Augustinus, & Ecclesiæ Catholicæ doctrinam retinuit:

page.notes: Left margin: the first note's book number is printed "lib. IL." in a worn italic; read as XI with [?]. The right-hand page is only an edge strip, cut off by the scan, so nothing is transcribed from it. A stain covers the upper-left area of the text block; the readings there are firm. The "[?]" marks the uncertain numeral only.
